reviews.title: Unprofessional
reviews.text: When this app first came out in 2015 I purchase it., let me repeat, and I paid for the app . I love using it since then I saw an update and I said I want my app to be working perfectly with no issues. I was scanning so important documents on my phone so that I can email it and now all of a sudden the new update blocked me from sending my own documents until I pay them a subscription fee, this is ridiculous. You need to change this back to its original version or just give me my money back.

reviews.title: Useless unless you spend money
reviews.text: The app itself works fine. Detects documents well and the scans look fine. But I’m not paying $3 a month for the rare occasion I need to scan something and save to my camera roll. App is completely useless if you don’t just save everything to Evernote, which I don’t even use. Just wanted a simple app to scan and save, but a subscription model is ridiculous. Would happily pay a dollar or two for the app itself. Subscription models have ruined everything.

reviews.title: Another good app ruined
reviews.text: Used to be incredibly useful, you could email scans of a page to yourself. Now all options to export are locked behind a pay wall and it gives you a ton of ads for their other app. Uninstalled immediately. Just use Microsoft lens instead. It’s also riddled with annoying ads for their premium plan but at least it actually lets you export

reviews.title: Log in daily!
reviews.text: this would be a really great app if I didn’t have to log in again to Evernote almost every time I open the app!

reviews.title: Update renders it unusable
reviews.text: Older version was working just fine.  New version, which I was forced to download to keep using the app, no longer allows me to share a single document; it’s all docs or nothing.  So I’m paying for Evernote and can no longer use the scanning app that’s supposed to pair with it.

reviews.text: Terrible app. Would not recommend. They let you scan the files but when you want to save them or share them you have to sign in to do anything. And they want you to pay to save them directly on your phone

reviews.title: Forced to pay to download photos
reviews.text: Absolutely gross they have decided to monetize every last aspect of this app. If you want to use the app now, you have to give your data away to Evernote so they can sell it to 3rd party vendors and/or retain valuable, sensitive data for years- or you have to PAY to download to your photo album. Do better.

reviews.title: Been horrid since Evernote acquired it
reviews.text: They make it deliberately so much worse than it used to be. Before I could just scan some pictures and send them to myself and now it’s all locked behind horrible Evernote paywall multi app dysfunction. It’s a no from me dawg.

reviews.title: No business card contact export
reviews.text: Evernote quit supporting auto export of business card scans to contacts, although it still touts it as a selling point.  This app is now useless. Also, important question, why is this app necessary as an Evernote subscriber?  There’s already a scan app within Evernote?  This is a redundant app only meant to help promote Evernote in the App Store when people are searching for scan apps.

reviews.title: So sad…
reviews.text: I’m the type who downloads numerous apps for each different type of task.. productivity apps happen to be my favorite category. I rarely pay for an app as I know chances are there is usually something comparable free. I know now you can use your iPhone to do scans, but I had been using scannable for years and it was one app that I was completely happy with. It was reliable, free, and worked perfectly!!  I could save my scans, email them, etc. whatever I needed but then suddenly like others have shared they changed everything and it now sucks. I’m definitely not going to pay when I can get the same thing if not better for free. What a waste of a good app. It’s really sad.

reviews.title: Ridiculous subscription change
reviews.text: I used to have to subscribe to Evernote to be able to save images to iPhone or email them. Now I've got to pay for another subscription just to do such a basic feature? Why would I use this app now?
this used to be the best scanner app and now it's like unusable without making account and downloading another app
